product_one_liner.value: Mohawk Global helps businesses manage supply chains through domestic and international freight transportation, customs brokerage, and trade-compliance consulting, with GlobalLink providing shipment tracking and visibility.

pricing_page.notes: The site directs prospective customers to request a transportation quote; I found no public pricing page.

eng_blog.notes: The public Knowledge Center index is industry and customer-facing content, not an engineering blog with multiple product-build posts.

public_docs.notes: The public API portal documents numerous endpoints for clients and partners.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current open-role inventory lists logistics, compliance, supply-chain, sales and account-executive roles, but no qualifying AI, ML or data-science title.

model_provider.notes: No model or provider was identified in the public product/API material, privacy information, or technical/blog materials reviewed.

compliance_certs.notes: The qualifications list names licenses, CTPAT validation and hazardous-material handling, but none of SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR or PCI DSS.

last_funding.notes: The funding profile says Mohawkglobal has not raised any funding rounds.

raised_18mo.notes: The company profile reports no funding rounds.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current open-role listing includes multiple Account Executive positions.

launched_6mo.notes: An August 2026 case study describes a newly built customized platform within GlobalLink for shared shipment visibility, automated routine tasks and exception management; this appears to be a major customer-specific product feature rather than a general release.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The executive roster is checkable, but a VP profile says Karen Damon joined without giving a date; I could not establish whether that join fell within the specified 12-month window.
